## Summary

Configure Live WebRTC sessions to pause when idle and resume on speech.

## Changes

- Set the speech wake policy, VAD threshold, and idle timeout in session
creation requests.
- Receive session.paused and session.resumed as typed sideband events.
- Read optional active and paused billable seconds in session usage.

## Validation

Ran the existing Live caller tests and a compatibility probe using the
released `float` type. The probe decoded fractional `seconds` and
checked the new optional counts and typed events.

Release notes

Sourced from anyio's releases.

4.16.0

New features

  • Added BlockingPortal.call_async() for asynchronously calling into an event loop with optional abandonment on cancellation (#1342; PR by @​davidbrochart)
  • Added SOCK_SEQPACKET support to connect_unix() and create_unix_listener() (#1349; PR by @​theunkn0wn1)

Other changes

  • Changed UDP sockets on the asyncio backend to make send() wait until the datagram has been passed to the operating system (#1294; PR by @​graingert)

Bug fixes

  • Fixed documentation implying that use_uvloop=True falls back to the standard event loop when uvloop (winloop on Windows) is not installed, and showed how to skip the corresponding pytest backend variant when the dependency is missing (#645; PR by @​GruffElixir)
  • Fixed get_current_task() on the asyncio backend raising an opaque TypeError: cannot create weak reference to 'NoneType' object instead of a clear error when called from a callback scheduled via loop.call_soon_threadsafe() (e.g. from within from_thread.run_sync()), where asyncio.current_task() is legitimately None (#773; PR by @​AmirF194)
  • Fixed CancelScope on the asyncio backend swallowing a native Task.cancel() that was delivered in the same event loop iteration as the scope's own cancellation (such as a move_on_after() deadline expiring), which left the host task with a pending cancellation request that never raised CancelledError (#1214)
  • Fixed UDP socket closing hanging if a datagram send was still in flight (#1237; PR by @​graingert)
  • Fixed concurrent aclose_forcefully() calls on asyncio socket streams returning before the underlying socket was closed (#1273; PR by @​graingert)
  • Fixed aclose() on sockets not checkpointing, and thus failing to raise a cancellation exception when called inside a cancelled scope (affected UNIX socket streams and UNIX datagram sockets on asyncio, and all sockets on Trio) (#1288; PR by @​graingert)
  • Fixed aclose() on asyncio TCP socket listeners not checkpointing, and leaking the listening socket if cancelled while another task was waiting in accept() (#1289; PR by @​graingert)
  • Fixed accept() on asyncio UNIX socket listeners hanging forever, and leaving the listening socket registered with the event loop, when the listener was closed by another task (#1289; PR by @​graingert)
  • Fixed send() on asyncio TCP and UDP sockets returning normally, despite the data being discarded, when the socket was closed by another task (or, for TCP, the connection was lost) while send() was waiting for the operating system to accept the data (#1289; PR by @​graingert)
  • Fixed SocketStream.send() on the asyncio backend handing its data to a paused transport after a previous send() was cancelled (#1299; PR by @​graingert)
  • Fixed sleep() treating a negative delay (including -inf) inconsistently across backends (asyncio returned immediately; Trio raised ValueError) by raising ValueError on all backends (#1306; PR by @​BetterAndBetterII)
  • Fixed create_tcp_listener() occasionally failing with a message like Could not create 2 listeners with a consistent port when an ephemeral port is requested and IPv6 is enabled and the dual-stack path is not available or a specific local host name was given (#1313)
  • Fixed AsyncFile not shielding against cancellation while closing (#1314)
  • Fixed TemporaryDirectory.cleanup() reacting to cancellation prematurely when the host task was already cancelled, causing the actual cleanup operation to be skipped (#1316; PR by @​Yasser-Ameur)
  • Fixed a NaN deadline being accepted on asyncio while Trio raised ValueError, which silently disabled the timeout (fail_after(math.nan) returned instead of raising TimeoutError); CancelScope now rejects it on both backends (#1317; PR by @​dylanpulver)
  • Fixed FileReadStream and FileWriteStream leaving files open when cancelled during context manager exit, including unflushed writes (#1318; PR by @​Kuang-xianxin)
  • Fixed Condition.notify() and Condition.notify_all() failing when the underlying lock was acquired directly rather than through the condition (#1319; PR by @​GruffElixir)
  • Fixed importing AnyIO with loaders that do not provide __file__, such as PyOxidizer, raising TypeError instead of falling back to eager imports (#1322; PR by @​skulitom)
  • Fixed text receive streams silently discarding incomplete characters at end-of-file instead of applying the configured decoding error handler (#1339; PR by @​Aurelucien)
  • Fixed Semaphore(fast_acquire=True) losing its fast-acquire behavior when instantiated outside a running event loop (#1348; PR by @​feiiiiii5)
  • Fixed BlockingPortalProvider permanently failing with an AttributeError on every subsequent use if the first attempt to start its blocking portal failed (#1350; PR by @​Yasser-Ameur)
  • Fixed create_udp_socket() silently ignoring the local_port argument when local_host was omitted, making the socket bind to a random ephemeral port instead of the requested one (#1351; PR by @​januththedev)
  • Fixed worker threads on the asyncio backend never returning to the idle pool (and thus never being reused or pruned) when a to_thread.run_sync() call was cancelled after it had been queued for the worker but before the worker thread had picked it up (#1352; PR by @​Zac-HD)
  • Fixed pytest plugin running Hypothesis async tests only on the first parametrized backend instead of each backend (#1353; PR by @​DYNOSuprovo)
  • Fixed TypeError when subclassing an existing TypedAttributeSet subclass, and this subclass contains type annotations (#1358; PR by @​pasmud)
  • Fixed Lock.locked() (and Condition.locked()) raising NoEventLoopError when the lock was created outside a running event loop (#1362; PR by @​00200200)
  • Fixed connect_tcp() leaking a connected socket when an enclosing cancel scope was cancelled before the connection attempt task group exited (#1364; PR by @​charan-rathore)
  • Fixed create_connected_udp_socket() silently ignoring local_port when local_host was not given: the local address was left unset, so the OS picked an ephemeral port instead of the requested one (#1365; PR by @​feiiiiii5)
  • Fixed BlockingPortalProvider not passing the exception raised in its with block on to the start_blocking_portal() context manager it wraps (#1366; PR by @​feiiiiii5)
  • Fixed anyio.itertools.islice() not consuming the first start items when stop <= start (#1372; PR by @​Rodrigo-Palma)
  • Fixed BufferedByteReceiveStream.receive_exactly() and receive_until() returning buffered data after explicit closure instead of raising ClosedResourceError (#1378; PR by @​kokotatan)
  • Fixed a TLS stream sending records the peer could no longer decrypt after a cancelled send() lost an already-encrypted record; the stream now raises BrokenResourceError on further use instead (#1385; PR by @​Kayvan-Zahiri)
  • Fixed close() on memory object streams not waking up tasks blocked in send() or receive() on the same stream (#1391)
  • Fixed anyio.itertools.product() acquiring and consuming unused input iterables when repeat=0 (#1394; PR by @​sricharanreddycheruku)
  • Fixed SpooledTemporaryFile rolling over to disk on writes when max_size is zero (the default) (#1397; PR by @​fhgffy)
  • Fixed Trio UDP sockets remaining open when initialization failed or was cancelled (#1400; PR by @​adenzhou1350)
  • Fixed SpooledTemporaryFile.rollover() moving the current file position to the end of the file (#1401; PR by @​fhgffy)
  • Fixed cancellation during temporary directory creation leaving the directory behind while its context manager is retained (#1403; PR by @​adenzhou1350)

Updates `playwright` from 1.64.1 to 1.65.0
Release notes

Sourced from playwright's releases.

v1.65.0

🧾 Locator code in Python

A locator from locator.normalize() now converts to a string as Python code. Use it with page.get_by_ref() to turn an element that an agent picks from a page.aria_snapshot() in the "ai" mode into code for your test:

normalized =
page.get_by_ref("e2").normalize()
print(str(normalized))
# get_by_role("button", name="Submit")

New APIs

  • New option timeout in cdp_session.send().

Notable Fixes ⚠️

  • Actions such as locator.click(), locator.check(), locator.tap(), locator.fill(), locator.clear() and locator.select_option() now wait for the element to be not inert. An action on an element with the inert attribute, or inside such an element, now times out if the element stays inert.

  • Cookie matching now follows RFC 6265. With a URL, browser_context.cookies() and api_request_context.cookies() no longer return host-only cookies for subdomains or Path=/api cookies for /apiv2, and a Path=/foo/ cookie does not match /foo. APIRequestContext sends a cookie without a name as Cookie: x instead of Cookie: =x, and stores Set-Cookie: token as a cookie without a name.

  • Proxy credentials are no longer sent to websites. The credentials in the proxy option now answer only proxy challenges. To authenticate on a website, use http_credentials.

  • Text that the browser does not render, such as text that is not assigned to a slot or text directly inside a closed <details>, is no longer part of accessible names and aria snapshots. This can change the results of page.get_by_role() with a name, locator.aria_snapshot() and expect(locator).to_match_aria_snapshot().

  • String values of the params option in APIRequestContext requests are now appended to the query that the URL already has, instead of replacing it.

Announcements

  • 🐍 The Python client is now a line-by-line port of the Node.js client, so it behaves the same way. The API did not change. If you see a change in behavior, file an issue.
  • 📦 Playwright now publishes a source distribution next to the wheels. It does not include Node.js, so installs that do not accept wheels now work, such as pip install --no-binary :all: and Poetry with installer.no-binary. An install from the source distribution uses a pre-installed Node.js that you set with PLAYWRIGHT_NODEJS_PATH.
  • 🧩 pyee is not a dependency anymore, so it no longer conflicts with packages that need a different version of it.

  • Mozilla Firefox 159.0
  • WebKit 27.2

feat(api): hide Managed Agents session budget controls and events (#4289)

## Summary

The SDK has been exposing Managed Agents session budget controls as
public types. This update removes the alpha budget API from those types.

This is an alpha breaking change for a **minor** release. If your
application depends on these members, stay on the previous SDK until you
can remove those references. There is no replacement typed budget API in

supersedes that narrower change; the old PR does not need to land first.

## Verification

The 278 focused SDK tests have been passing (6 skipped), along with Ruff
and formatting. The tests cover preserving a generic error, ignoring
unrelated unknown frames, and ending a helper's wait when a matching
opaque budget frame arrives.

feat(api): type Managed Agents budget events (#4284)

## Summary

Adds typed budget notifications to Managed Agents session streams.

## Changes

- Accept `None` for `spend_control.limit` on uncapped sessions.
- Expose `AgentSessionBudgetReachedEvent` and the `budget_reached`
session status.
- Result collection has been stopping at a matching budget event before
the first root turn or after a finished root turn. During an active root
turn it has been continuing to read.

The offline replay has been covering sync and async creation and
subscription with named and unnamed SSE frames. Each stream has been
yielding the typed `error` followed by `agent.session.budget_reached`.
The tests have been checking both numeric and explicit-null limits. The
sync and async result tests have been checking that collection stops at
the budget event after an error, before reading the next event.

commit.message:
feat(api): deliver beta Agents session errors as stream events (#4281)

Both sync and async streaming session creation and event subscriptions
have been yielding in-band errors and subsequent session events in
order. This follows the beta Agents delivery behavior in [Node
#3120](https://github.com/openai/openai-node/pull/3120).

Existing method signatures and other streams' default error behavior
have been staying compatible. HTTP failures and malformed SSE payloads
have still been following the usual error paths.

An SSE replay has been confirming that the SDK yields an in-band `error`
followed by the next session event with its full payload for both
streaming session creation and event subscriptions.

Focused streaming and Agents tests have been passing with 285 passed and
40 skipped, including all four sync and async entry points. The
transformed OpenAPI has been matching the public baseline byte for byte.
